title: spec: `describeManagedApiMethodConflicts` is a published export with no production caller, and its sentence still prescribes `userActions` on a `synced` object
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag

Out-of-scope finding of #32134 (PR #33517, dev report 6885841810; seat amendment 6885418970). Class b, published text / dead surface.

**What is there:** `packages/spec/src/data/managed-api-affordance.ts` exports `describeManagedApiMethodConflicts(conflicts)`, whose sentence ends "(needs userActions …) — see ADR-0092 / ADR-0103". Since the lint rule `object/managed-api-method-unaffordable` builds its own message (`packages/lint/src/validate-managed-api-methods.ts`; the lint CHANGELOG records it "no longer appends the spec's `describeManagedApiMethodConflicts` sentence"), the helper has **no production caller** in this repo, only its own test. It receives no bucket (`ManagedApiMethodConflict` is `verb`/`needs`/`index`), so on a `synced` object (ADR-0153 D4, PR #32118) its sentence points at a key the parse refuses. PR #33517 fixes the two sentences an author actually sees and leaves this export untouched by ruling.

**TO (the lane picks one, measured first):**
- **Retire:** confirm no consumer outside this repo needs it (cloud, objectui, published docs/skills that name it), then remove the export through the repo's removal route (deprecation note or a semver-appropriate removal with changeset).
- **Or align:** if a consumer exists, make the sentence true on every bucket without widening the signature (e.g. drop the userActions remedy clause, or point at the lint rule).

`Clause-②`: per the route chosen (a removal narrows the published surface). Lane spec, Grade p3 (dead export, wrong only where nobody reads it today).

class: b · type: Cleanup · Grade: p3 · domain: spec
